question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8fb16fcb9e167b7b25e61121ea810ffcef30d456eb9303d9b8b02a7e62dfdc1.png]
solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/960d11a978efb9a675053f30057363a1df12c8c7a4be012fcbb132b86c407e91.png] 

As we move along the series:

 
• One line increases in each step.
 
• Number of sides in the figure increases by one: Triangle → Quadrilateral → Pentagon → Hexagon
 
• Letter series: D + 2 = F; F + 2 = H; H + 2 = J

Hence, '**option 1**' is the correct answer.
